title: Etale sheaves over an algebraically closed field are constant
statement: Let $\Omega$ be an algebraically closed field and let $G$ be a sheaf of sets on the small etale site $(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega)_{\Et}$ [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-etale-site, def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaf-of-sets]. The canonical morphism from the constant sheaf with value $\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,G)$ [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf] to $G$ is an isomorphism, naturally in $G$. Under the identity geometric point $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to\operatorname{Spec}\Omega$, this isomorphism identifies $\Gamma(\operatorname{Spec}\Omega,G)$ with the geometric stalk $G_{\mathrm{id}}$ [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks].
